时笙没有进入D县，千黎这情况除了第一次，后来还有一次，她知道他是要晋级了。

晋级完他会回来找她。

所以她完全无视了后面三只叽叽喳喳的讨论什么——

丧尸的性生活。

讲真，如果可以，她很想把这三只扔到丧尸堆里去，这特么都什么话题。

你们难道就不应该讨论，她作为一个人类，为什么可以让丧尸听话这种牛逼的话题吗？

本宝宝不太懂这些人类的思维。

B市安全区的人来得比较慢，时笙他们等了大半天，几辆绿皮卡车才停在D县外面。

领头的是个熟人，常新。

他们分了队，然后合力进入D县，时笙远远的跟在他们后面。

“疯子，你发现没有，这些丧尸好像不攻击我们。”清玉推了一把林风。

被清玉这么一提醒，林风扫了一圈四周，四周的丧尸都远远的跟着，没有一个发动攻击。

两人同时看向走在前面，犹如后花园漫步的少女。

唯一的解释就只有她。

两人对视一眼，拉着小胖又靠近了时笙几步。

进入D县，常新就把人分开了，时笙自然跟着戚明雪。

戚明雪占了先机，又有金手指，是最早到达三级的异能者。

但是宋拾也不差，两人配合得非常默契，杀起丧尸来，事半功倍。

很快他们就到了一栋建筑，看上去像是某种科研研究所。

他们像清怪一般的一层一层的清上去，人不多，所以没人清理战场。

时笙几人跟在后面，麻溜的替他们打扫战场，一个晶核也没放过。

这些人清理到目标为止，等拿了东西出来，发现里面的晶核都不见了，还没弄清楚怎么回事，发现刚才清理过的地方又布满了丧尸。

就跟定时刷新似的。

“怎么这么多丧尸，你们没有留人吗？”苏霁夜看向他们身后的一群人。

那些人纷纷看向身边的人，大约意思就是，你们没留人？

没有啊，我以为你们留了。

你们也没留啊？

都以为对方会留人，结果所有人都没留……

这就尴尬了。

Shi Sheng did not enter County D. Besides the first time, Qian Li also had another situation later. She knew that he was going to be promoted.

He will come back to her after promotion.

So she completely ignored what the three chattering behind them were discussing——

Zombie sex life.

To be honest, if she could, she would really like to throw these three into the zombie pile. This is no topic.

Shouldn't you discuss the awesome topic of why, as a human being, she can make zombies obey her orders?

This baby doesn't quite understand these human thoughts.

People from the safety zone in City B arrived relatively slowly. Shi Sheng and the others waited for most of the day before several green pickup trucks parked outside County D.

The leader was an acquaintance, Chang Xin.

They divided into teams and entered D County together, with Shi Sheng following them from a distance.

"Madman, have you noticed that these zombies don't seem to attack us." Qingyu pushed Lin Feng.

After being reminded by Qingyu, Lin Feng scanned the surrounding area. The zombies all around followed him from a distance, but none of them launched an attack.

The two of them looked at the girl walking in front, like a stroll in the back garden.

The only explanation is her.

The two looked at each other and took Xiaopang a few steps closer to Shi Sheng.

After entering D County, Chang Xin separated the people, and Shi Sheng naturally followed Qi Mingxue.

Qi Mingxue had the upper hand and had a golden finger. She was the first to reach level three.

But Song Shi is not bad either. The two of them cooperate very well and kill zombies with twice the result with half the effort.

Soon they arrived at a building that looked like some kind of scientific research institute.

They cleared it up layer by layer like monsters. There were not many people, so no one was clearing the battlefield.

Shi Sheng and others followed behind and quickly cleaned the battlefield for them, not sparing a single crystal core.

These people cleaned up to the target. When they took the things out, they found that the crystal cores inside were gone. Before they could figure out what was going on, they found that the place they had just cleaned was filled with zombies again.

It's like a scheduled refresh.

"Why are there so many zombies? Didn't you leave anyone behind?" Su Jiye looked at the group of people behind them.

Those people looked at the people around them, probably meaning, you didn't leave anyone behind?

No, I thought you stayed.

You didn't stay either?

Everyone thought that the other party would keep people, but in the end, no one stayed...

This is embarrassing.
